# gateway

Traefik as the Gateway API implementation, and the cluster's one Gateway.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-interface.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-floe-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| chart | string | *(required)* | Store path of the Traefik Helm chart. Required — the caller pins it in `lib/charts.nix` and interpolates it.  A path and not the derivation: `instantiate` deep-forces its inputs to check them eagerly, and a derivation is a self-referential attrset, so passing one overflows the stack before the floe is ever linked.  |
| className | string | `"traefik"` | GatewayClass the Gateway names. Traefik's chart installs it. |
| gatewayName | string | `"default-gateway"` | Name of the Gateway resource routes attach to. |
| httpPort | 16 bit unsigned integer; between 0 and 65535 (both inclusive) | `8000` | Listener port. Traefik's chart maps its `web` entrypoint to 8000 in the pod and exposes it on 80, so the listener has to name the pod's port and not the service's.  |
| httpsPort | 16 bit unsigned integer; between 0 and 65535 (both inclusive) | `8443` | TLS listener port. Traefik maps its `websecure` entrypoint to 8443 in the pod and exposes it on 443, so the listener names the pod's port.  |
| namespace | string | `"kube-system"` | Namespace the controller and the Gateway live in. Neither bundle creates it: `kube-system` is one the cluster ships with, and emitting a Namespace object for it would have the applier adopt it.  |
| tlsEnable | boolean | `false` | Terminate TLS on the Gateway, signed by whatever provides X509_ISSUANCE. Off by default: a lab with no issuer in its link cannot serve https, and quietly rendering a listener with no certificate produces a Gateway that never programs.  |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | KUBERNETES_CLUSTER | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |
| gatewayApi | GATEWAY_API | The Gateway API CRDs are registered, so Gateway and route kinds have types. |
| issuance | X509_ISSUANCE | Something that signs certificates, and whether a browser will trust what it signs. |
| zone | DNS_ZONE | The lab's DNS zone and the server authoritative for it. The only fully portable signature. |
